item.title: Major U.S. banks turned away customers over political and religious views, report says
item.description:
The Comptroller of the Currency says the nation's nine largest banks denied financial services to customers based on their political, religious, or social beliefs, according to a regulatory review released Wednesday.

The OCC reviewed nearly 100,000 complaints and received approximately 50,000 documents from JPMorgan Chase Bank, Bank of America, Citibank, Wells Fargo Bank, U.S. Bank, Capital One, PNC Bank, TD Bank, and BMO Bank regarding their policies, procedures, practices, and individual customer decisions.

The federal banking watchdog determined that the banks' sweeping internal guidelines lacked objective, risk-based criteria, effectively shutting out legitimate customers and businesses based on ideological leanings rather than financial risk.

The OCC said its findings reveal a systematic effort within the banking sector to restrict access for politically sensitive industries through both public and nonpublic policies.

Federal regulators found that lenders restricted certain sectors' access to financial services, including oil and gas exploration; coal mining; firearms or ammunition manufacturing or distribution; construction or operation of detention facilities; and the manufacturing, distribution or online retail of tobacco or e-cigarettes.

The Trump administration has voiced growing concerns over "de-banking" and the use of the financial system to achieve social and political objectives.

"Today's report provides irrefutable evidence that the nation's largest banks have denied, debanked, and discriminated against customers and lawful businesses," said Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould. "Americans should have access to financial services regardless of their beliefs, affiliations, or political views. "

All nine banks report having reassessed the role of reputation risk in decisions to accept or terminate new customers, according to the OCC's report. Several banks said they had minimized reliance on reputation risk, and bank employees now must consider it in the context of other financial or business consequences, including credit risk, money laundering and terrorist financing risk.

The Bank Policy Institute, a lobbying group that represents the banks, said in a statement in reaction to the report, "We support efforts to establish clear and consistent standards that promote access while maintaining sound risk management, including the administration's recent efforts to prioritize supervisory attention on material financial risk and rather than reputational risk."

The group also noted it would continue to work with the administration and Congress on proposals that ensure that political or religious beliefs do not unfairly affect customers' access to banking services.

JPMorgan Chase said in a statement, "We take this seriously, learned from it, and improved the way we do business. We agree with the Administration on a broader point: years of operating in a regulatory environment that often second-guessed decisions contributed to a culture of caution across the banking industry. That system needs fixing."

The bank says its policies prohibit discrimination against customers based on political or religious views.

A spokesperson for Wells Fargo and Citigroup declined to comment on the OCC's report, while PNC said it was reviewing the findings.

Bank of America, U.S. Bank and Capital One had not responded for comment as of this writing.

The review was directed by President Trump's executive order, "Guaranteeing Fair Access to Banking for All Americans," to determine whether these banks' policies or practices required or influenced banks to deny or limit access to financial services to Americans because of their political or religious beliefs or lawful business activities.

The OCC is considering further actions and writing new rules to prevent banks from discriminating against customers or prospective customers based on their political or religious beliefs. The OCC is also coordinating its debanking review with the reviews of other federal and state partners.

"Notwithstanding certain efforts by the largest banks to rein in these practices, I am not confident that they will be enough," said Gould.

Jennifer Schonberger is a veteran financial journalist covering markets, the economy, and investing. At Yahoo Finance, she covers the Federal Reserve, Congress, the White House, the Treasury, the SEC, the economy, cryptocurrencies, and the intersection of Washington policy with finance. Follow her on X @Jenniferisms and on Instagram.

David Hollerith is a senior reporter at Yahoo Finance covering the cryptocurrency and stock markets. Follow him on X at @DsHollers.

item.title: GTA 6 可能提前发布 PC 版本
item.description: Rockstar 尚未正式宣布，但有报道称它计划于 2027 年第一季度发布 GTA 6 的 PC 版本，与主机版本仅仅相隔几个月。GTA 6 将于 2026 年 11 月发布主机版本。据彭博报道，在 GTA 6 开发过程中 Rockstar 员工总数从开发 Red Dead Redemption II 的 2,441 人增长到 4,711 人。GTA 6 制作预算据称超过 20 亿美元，提前释出 PC 版本旨在加快回收制作费用。上一代 GTA 5 的主机版本和 PC 版本相隔 1 年 7 个月，而 GTA 5 的主要受众是主机玩家，PC 玩家占少数。如今 PC 玩家的规模已经显著扩大。加快发布 PC 版本也有助于扩大 GTA 6 的受众规模。

item.title: 研究估计到 2050 年每年新增痴呆症人数将会翻倍
item.description: 一项新研究估计，2023 年有 1140 万人患上痴呆症，到 2050 年预计这一数字将增加一倍以上，新增痴呆症人数将达到 2470 万。研究发现女性的痴呆症发病率高于男性，且低中收入国家的发病率远高于高收入国家。在校正年龄因素后，女性发病为每千人年 10.6 例，男性为 8.6 例。低中收入国家的发病率为每千人年 13.6 例，而高收入国家为 8.3 例。目前全世界有逾 5700 万人受痴呆症困扰，到 2050 年这一数字将达到 1.5 亿。每年新增 2400 万痴呆症病例，将给个人、家庭、卫生系统及经济带来巨大压力。

item.title: Can Trump strip Ilhan Omar of her U.S. citizenship? It's not that simple.
item.description:
In a highly unusual step, federal agents this week aggressively intensified their investigations into Democratic Rep. Ilhan Omar of Minnesota, weeks before she stands for reelection in her home district. 

The Department of Justice on Tuesday subpoenaed relatives of Omar’s family members, including her sister Sahra Noor, according to The New York Times. The grand jury subpoenas were issued shortly after a raid of the lawmaker’s residence in Washington, D.C. on Monday. 

The judicial search warrant, which is under seal, was executed by Homeland Security Investigations, the investigative branch of Immigration and Customs Enforcement. Although the Department of Justice did not provide any more details of the investigation, multiple outlets, citing anonymous sources, reported that the search stemmed from Omar’s immigration paperwork, which was filled out by her late father when she was a child. 

Prior to the investigation, multiple Trump Administration officials have accused Omar of immigration fraud without presenting any evidence. In a podcast interview in March, Vice President JD Vance said the White House was exploring “legal remedies” to her alleged immigration fraud. Last month, Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said the investigation into Omar was “ongoing” and dismissed efforts to frame the case as political retribution.

“If we actually move a case forward, it’s not a political case. It's actually a case because they did things wrong,” Mullin said during the interview with right-wing podcaster Benny Johnson. 

Omar, who has long denied the allegations, condemned the raid on her home as “political intimidation” and said she will “not be silenced.” 

President Trump, along with many MAGA Republicans, has repeatedly floated the idea of revoking Omar’s citizenship, a process also known as denaturalization, and deporting her. 

But legal and immigration experts tell TIME that denaturalizing a U.S. citizen is a rare and difficult process, one that requires federal authorities to clear a high bar in front of a federal judge. Here’s what to know about how the process works. 

How does denaturalization work?

Stripping someone of their citizenship is a more arduous legal process than most other immigration efforts that involve the courts. Deportation proceedings, for instance, are initiated by ICE agents under the Department of Homeland Security and are then approved by immigration judges who are hired and work within the Department of Justice. The denaturalization process, on the other hand, must be approved by an independent federal judge, who evaluates the request by a higher standard.  

All denaturalization efforts begin at DOJ. In order to revoke a naturalized person’s citizenship, a DOJ lawyer must decide whether to file a civil or a criminal petition in court. Yuripzy Morgan, an attorney and host of Free Range National podcase, said a civil complaint does not have a statute of limitation, whereas a criminal complaint has a statute of limitation of 10 years and must clear a much higher legal bar. 

“For civil denaturalization, the government has to show that there is clear, convincing, and unequivocal evidence that the person in question obtained their naturalization either illegally, or they willfully misrepresented a material fact, ” Morgan says. She stressed that simply having an error in an immigration document doesn't mean that a judge is going to approve stripping a person of their citizenship. 

For a criminal denaturalization conviction, the federal government must show “proof beyond a reasonable doubt” that the individual knowingly obtained citizenship through fraud, which is the highest legal standard of proof required to secure a criminal conviction. In 2017, the Supreme Court unanimously ruled in Maslenjak v. United States that only an illegal act that played a role in a person’s citizenship application could lead to criminal denaturalization, further narrowing down the scope of such efforts. 

Omar’s father filled out and submitted her citizenship application on her behalf when she was 17. It is unclear what evidence, if any, the federal government has to show that anything in the application was fraudulent, or that Omar or her father intentionally misrepresented anything in that application. 

Andrew Arthur, a former immigration judge and a resident fellow at the Center for Immigration Studies, pointed out that even after someone gets denaturalized, a deportation is not guaranteed. The person would still be able to retain their previous legal immigration status until a final order of removal is issued to the person by ICE.

“If they had a green card before they naturalized, even after they get denaturalized, they are going to have a green card,” Arthur says. 

How did Rep. Omar get naturalized as a U.S. citizen?

According to Omar’s House biography, Omar and her family fled her home country Somalia when she was eight. The family eventually sought asylum in the United States in 1995. She told The New York Times that she became a U.S. citizen in 2000 when she was 17. 

At the time Omar went through the process, federal law allowed immigrants under the age of 18 to get naturalized as U.S. citizens if both of their parents had become U.S. citizens. The law was eventually replaced by a new law in 2001, which only requires one parent to become a citizen for the children to be naturalized. 

At the center of this investigation is whether Omar’s father, Nur Omar Mohamed, lied about her age in immigration documents so she could be eligible to derive citizenship through him, according to The Washington Post, which cited two unnamed sources. 

According to Arthur, the former immigration judge, if Omar was 18 at the time of the naturalization application, she may have been able to apply for her citizenship on her own after having a valid green card for five years. 

The allegations regarding Omar’s citizenship gained attention among conservative activists and commentators starting in 2019, when Omar became a member of Congress. Shortly after her election, Omar’s staff sought to change her official birth year in public records from 1981 to 1982, according to multiple outlets.

How often does the U.S. government strip people of their citizenship?

Despite the renewed push from the second Trump administration, denaturalization remains an exceedingly rare legal process. According to the Migration Policy Institute, a Washington, D.C.-based think tank, an average of 11 denaturalization cases were filed per year between 1990 and 2017. 

Denaturalization efforts have increased in Trump’s second term. The DOJ has announced efforts to strip at least 108 people of their citizenship in 2026. That is still considerably smaller than the hundreds of thousands of people whom the U.S. government grants citizenship to through naturalization every year.

This article originally appeared on Time at https://time.com/article/2026/10/14/ilhan-omar-citizenship-investigation-denaturalization-DOJ/

来源: 
博谈网

美国怀俄明大学32岁中国籍微生物学研究生王爱丽，因涉嫌向同学饮品中投放神经毒性化学物丙烯酰胺，面临加重袭击和殴打重罪指控。她10月6日在洛杉矶国际机场准备离境时被捕。

警方宣誓书称，受害者此前出现严重疲乏、失眠及其他异常症状，其泡茶器具中随后检测出异常含量的丙烯酰胺。调查人员还发现，王爱丽今年夏天曾两次通过eBay购买该化学物，但接受警方询问时声称多年未使用。监控录像据称还拍到她接触受害者杯具、翻阅并拍摄对方研究资料。

检方称，王爱丽被捕时携带多部电脑、外接存储设备及书面材料，并以存在逃亡风险为由要求提高保释金。案件尚未审判，被告依法仍被推定无罪。

item.title: A mysterious death in Russia renews fears about ancient viruses trapped in Siberia
item.description:
The unexplained death this month of a Russian lab technician at a Siberian facility for the study of dangerous pathogens raised global anxieties over the potential for an outbreak of pneumonic plague.

But while the cause of concern - bound up in a lack of transparency from Moscow - was new, Russia’s frozen hinterlands have long been the source of a separate fear that they could harbor disease risks for which the world is not prepared.

Subscribe to The Post Most newsletter for the most important and interesting stories from The Washington Post.

Russian authorities imposed containment measures after the 28-year-old’s death from what they said was pneumonia of “unknown origins,” prompting the United States to ask for more information. A World Health Organization report released Saturday said that Russian authorities found no signs of an outbreak of plague or some other infectious disease, but did not provide sufficient details to identify the origin of the woman’s illness or say whether exposure at work played a role in it.

Siberia’s vast wilderness harbors natural reservoirs of pathogens, from fleas that spread plague found in marmots and squirrels to ticks bearing encephalitis to the ancient pathogens frozen in the layer of permafrost.

The Russian institute where the lab technician worked was set up in the 1930s as a plague prevention station to curb outbreaks of the deadly bacterial disease that periodically affected local populations as well as people in neighboring Mongolia and China’s Manchuria region. The disease, for which early antibiotic treatments were pioneered that decade, could be spread through contact with marmots, which were hunted for meat and sometimes eaten undercooked or even raw, like in a 2019 case of a Mongolian couple.

The settlement of Siberia, which had a 19th-century gold rush and served as a place of exile for criminals under the Russian Empire, connected the remote region to the western parts of the empire and raised the risk of plague spreading farther west, much as epidemic diseases from European Russia, such as cholera and typhus, easily reached Siberia through migrating workers and because of the near-total absence of medical care.

A study published this year suggested that the bands of hunter-gatherers who inhabited the Lake Baikal region were the victims of the earliest known plague outbreak, about 5,500 years ago. To this day, plague remains endemic in parts of Siberia and the Russian Far East, where the bacterium persists naturally among wild rodents.

Human cases in Russia are rare, however. The country’s last recorded human infection was in 2016, when a 10-year-old boy in the Altai region contracted plague after contact with a marmot.

The threat of dangerous disease comes not only from wildlife but also from the millennia-old microbes and viruses stored in the permafrost that underlies the vast majority of the region.

About a decade ago, a group of researchers isolated “zombie viruses” from Siberian permafrost, raising fears that a new global medical emergency could be triggered by a disease from the distant past.

The permafrost, a dark, cold, oxygenless mass, is a perfect storage container for biological material, and scientists believe that at its deepest levels it may contain viruses up to a million years old, far older than Homo sapiens, the modern human species.

In 2023, the researchers - led by Jean-Michel Claverie of Aix-Marseille University in France - published a landmark study in the journal Viruses documenting the revival of ancient viruses from the Siberian permafrost.

The report warned that accelerating permafrost thaw caused by climate change poses a potential public health threat by releasing dormant pathogens. Claverie’s team isolated 13 ancient viruses taken from locations across Siberia, belonging to five new viral groups. The oldest, a Pandoravirus yedoma, had been frozen solid beneath an underground lake for 48,500 years, while other, younger strains (around 27,000 years old) were extracted from the remains of a woolly mammoth’s stomach and from mammoth wool.

Other researchers have noted that although the revived viruses were able to infect amoebas in lab conditions, it is unclear whether such viruses could infect animals or humans, or find a host outside a controlled laboratory.

Claverie and his team cautioned at the time that unknowns remain buried in the permafrost, and a warming climate, which would also open previously untouched lands to deeper development, could expose people to pathogens that affect humans.

In 2016, climate change played a role in unleashing anthrax in the remote Yamalo-Nenets region of Siberia, experts said at the time. Unusually high temperatures that summer, soaring to 95 degrees Fahrenheit, melted permafrost, and according to one hypothesis, exposed an infected reindeer carcass. The pathogen spread to living reindeer and eventually to a community of nomadic herders, where a 12-year-old boy died.

Related Content

This article originally appeared on Washington Post at https://washingtonpost.com/world/2026/10/14/dangerous-pathogens-have-lurked-millennia-russias-frozen-lands/

item.title: As inflation rises, poll finds 4 in 10 Americans struggle to afford basic necessities
item.description:
More than 4 in 10 Americans said they are struggling to afford basic living costs amid rising inflation levels in the country, according to polling data released Wednesday. 

The Pew Research Center surveys, which were conducted in late July and August, found that 44 percent of U.S. adults reported struggling to pay for basic necessities like medical care, rent or mortgage, transportation and food. 

Rising costs had an even greater impact on lower income Americans, as 71 percent of those surveyed said they struggled with costs for at least one of these expense categories. 

Additionally, 60 percent of people said they did not have enough income to “lead the kind of life they want,” while 53 percent said they did not have sufficient emergency funds. 

The inflation rate in August was 3.4 percent, down from 3.7 percent in July. Since then, the Bureau of Labor Statistics has reported further increases to the consumer price index, including a 0.6 percent increase in September. 

Gas prices have accounted for a sizable share of the inflation rate increases, as the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz during the Iran war placed a sustained strain on global energy supplies. 

A gallon of regular gas was around $4.33 a gallon in the U.S. on Wednesday afternoon, up from about $3.08 a year ago, according to AAA. The average cost of diesel has also spiked to more than $6 a gallon — an increase of more than $2 from last year.

President Trump has attempted to calm concerns about rising costs of living amid this conflict and his administration’s tariff fight with Canada ahead of the midterm elections, in which affordability is expected to be a top issue for voters at the ballot box. 

During a Tuesday campaign rally in Alaska, the president did not offer hope that the months-long conflict was nearing a close, telling the crowd he has “had it” with Iran’s leaders and added that his administration was “going to do a number” on the country.

The Pew report released Wednesday was based on findings from two surveys among a sample of 5,166 U.S. adults with a margin of error of approximately 1.6 percentage points. One poll was conducted from Aug. 24-30, while the other was conducted from July 20 to Aug. 9.

item.description:
美国股市周三创7月以来最大单日跌幅，标普500指数下跌1.1%，纳斯达克指数下跌1.9%。美国9月CPI同比上涨3.7%，超出预期，推动市场提高对美联储加息的预期。科技股遭遇集中抛售，甲骨文、戴尔及CoreWeave大幅下跌。 投资者担忧高利率加重AI基础设施企业的债务负担，而企业AI实际支出尚不足以支撑巨额投资。巴克莱下调多家硬件厂商评级，中国存储芯片技术进展也加剧了行业竞争担忧。美联储褐皮书释放滞胀信号，市场将密切关注周四公布的生产者价格指数。

item.title: Supreme Court sides with GOP in fight over discounted ads ahead of midterms
item.description:
By John Kruzel

WASHINGTON, Oct 14 (Reuters) - The US Supreme Court again sided with Republicans on Wednesday in the latest clash over a new Federal Communications Commission policy that gives party committees access to discounted TV and radio advertising rates long available to political candidates.

The court agreed to ‌let the FCC, which is chaired by Trump ally Brendan Carr, avoid a judicially imposed deadline that would have forced the agency to rule ‌on a Democratic challenge to the policy before the November 3 midterm elections. The FCC joined two Republican committees in filing a request to the Supreme Court to lift the lower court's deadline.

The court ​has a 6-3 conservative majority. Liberal Justices Sonia Sotomayor and Ketanji Brown Jackson indicated they would have denied the request.

The FCC, which currently has a 2-1 Republican majority, modified its so-called "lowest unit charge" rule in March in a move seen as a boost to President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans. The president's party is seeking to retain control of Congress in the November 3 midterms.

"We are pleased the Supreme Court has granted the FCC's stay request. The court's decision is right on the law and avoids the specter of upending ‌the rules for political ads right in the middle of ⁠an ongoing election," an FCC spokesperson said.

Chief Justice John Roberts had previously lifted the October 9 deadline that was given to the FCC by the Richmond-based 4th US Circuit Court of Appeals. The 4th Circuit has accused the FCC of repeated "delay tactics" in ⁠the case, and emphasized the need for an urgent ruling in the Democratic challenge given the looming election.

The Supreme Court's latest action marks the second time in recent weeks that it has addressed the FCC's policy, as major Republican committees head toward the midterms with a cash advantage over their Democratic counterparts.

In September, the court granted a request by the national Republican ​committees ​that support the party's candidates in Senate and House of Representatives races to revive the policy ​after the 4th Circuit blocked it. The justices in an ‌8-1 ruling said that the Democratic candidates must wait for the FCC to rule before filing a challenge in court.

The FCC policy at issue requires broadcasters to charge discounted rates for airing certain political advertisements within 60 days of a general election, a window that opened this year on September 4.

A group of Democratic candidates including Senator Jon Ossoff of Georgia in April challenged the policy through in-house proceedings at the FCC. When the agency took no action, the Democrats successfully challenged the policy in the 4th Circuit, a ruling that was later halted by the Supreme Court.

The 4th Circuit on October 7 ordered the FCC to issue a prompt ruling on the ‌Democratic in-house challenge, more than five months after it was filed. In its 2-1 ruling, the ​4th Circuit said its "willingness to tolerate the FCC's delay tactics is at an end."

'TRENCH WARFARE'

The Republican committees ​in their Supreme Court filing accused the 4th Circuit of having "short-circuited" the ​FCC's review process.

The Democratic candidates, for their part, accused the FCC in court papers of engaging in "blatant procedural trench warfare to stave ‌off judicial review of an unlawful agency directive until it is ​too late to matter."

The FCC policy gained ​greater significance after the Supreme Court in June struck down federal restrictions on spending coordinated between parties and their candidates, siding with Republican challengers including Vice President JD Vance. Since the June ruling, Republican committees have blown past the former limits ahead of the midterms.

The two Republican committees have exceeded the ​former national caps by more than $48 million, according to Federal ‌Election Commission spending disclosures for July and August. Their Democratic counterparts also eclipsed the former limits, but by much less — just under $4 million.

The three ​main national Republican committees ended August with about $233 million in cash. Their Democratic counterparts held roughly $130 million but also carried nearly $18 million in ​debt, according to Federal Election Commission filings.

(Reporting by John Kruzel; Editing by Will Dunham)

This article originally appeared on Reuters at https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/us-supreme-court-again-backs-204225313.html

item.title: 彭定求锯楼
item.description:
来源: 
正见网

张秀才不怒邻人杀子

张秀才，寿州人，生性任侠，重义气，喜欢结交当世奇士。寿州民风尚武，家家户户有兵器。一天，邻居买回一杆鸟枪，夜深无人时在家边试枪。枪响后忽然听到哭号声，邻居急忙去看，竟然是张秀才儿子走夜路被流弹打死了。邻居吓坏了，说：“打死别人的儿子尚且不行，何况打死张秀才的儿子呢！”于是带着家人一起跪在张秀才门口，哭着告诉张秀才，说：“任您处置。”张秀才说：“你岂敢故意杀我儿子，一定是无意的，是我儿子命中该死。而且怎么知道不是我不讲道德，天降惩罚，让我遭到杀子的报应呢？”叫邻居买棺材埋葬儿子，没有别的要求。张秀才当时已经五十多岁了，邻居想报答他的恩德，买个小妾献给他。张秀才开始不接受，邻居勉强他才接受了，后来小妾生了两个儿子。天意本来叫张秀才无后，张秀才的善念使自己又有了后代。

陆韵梅夫人仁恕

侍郎潘曾莹和原配夫人陆韵梅都擅长书法绘画，被朋友誉为“潘江陆海”。陆韵梅夫人生性仁恕，每逢大雨初歇，听到门前有卖瓜果的声音，就说：“天气这么冷，谁买呀？挑担子空把肩膀挑红了！”叫仆人将小贩瓜果全部买下。

一天，婢女不慎，掉了两个瓶子，一个碎了，一个完好无损。陆韵梅夫人不是责骂婢女，而是指给儿子们看，教育说：“你们记住：薄者破，厚者完。（刻薄破家，宽厚保家）”

黄凯钧让地

嘉庆甲子年，嘉善大水，米价腾贵。县官下令平价卖米，当时许多米商藏米不卖。唯独黄凯钧身体力行，不顾酷暑烈日，打伞步行，挨家挨户调查人口多少，定量卖平价米，极少有遗漏的人家，救活了很多百姓。

黄凯钧曾经将屋旁空地借给别人，后来别人久借不还，并且翻脸不认账，辱骂他。黄凯钧一笑了之，从此不提此事。

黄凯钧又买邻居房子，而邻居房子已经租给别人开商店了，生意不错，黄凯钧担心商店老板被迫搬走后生意失利，就毁掉已经立好的合同。

彭定求锯楼

乾隆年间，彭定求家中建楼，已经立好了柱子。有朋友造访说风水先生看了，说楼太高，对自己家无碍，但对邻居家有妨。彭定求说：“太容易解决了，将柱子锯掉一尺长，就不妨碍邻居风水了。”朋友说：“你为自己建楼，又不是帮邻居建楼，应该自己怎么舒服怎么来，何必考虑邻居呢？”彭定求说：“楼稍微矮一点，尽可安居，何必妨碍邻居呢？”于是将柱子锯短。

（据《清稗类钞》）

2010年11月29日

作者: 
史鉴

item.title: 从广州到香港，再到美国
item.description:
来源: 
来稿

张凤群成长于广州。她的父亲张迺棠是一名医生，1949年12月结束在香港的诊所业务，带着家人返回广州，在和平路开设“张迺棠心肺诊所”。诊所设在一栋四层洋楼的一层，楼上三层供全家居住。

张迺棠以心肺、呼吸系统疾病诊治见长，使用从香港带回的德国X光机为病人做肺部检查。一些在医院未能确诊的病例，也会转到他的诊所进一步判断。

张凤群少年时期就读于广州市第三中学。家庭生活相对优裕，她会弹钢琴，曾在学校活动中为同学伴奏，也参加过少年宫演出。

1966年“文化大革命”开始后，张家多次被抄。张凤群后来回忆，父母曾被红卫兵拉去批斗，全家最终被赶出原来的住所。她的父母和姐姐被遣送回乡，她与在卫生系统工作的两个哥哥以及八十多岁的外婆，搬到广州十三行荣阳街一间没有自来水和电的小木屋居住。

张凤群的父母后来回到广东新会乡下。当地乡亲腾出房子供他们居住，附近村民仍来找张迺棠看病，报酬往往不是现金，而是一只鸡、一块猪肉、几棵瓜菜，或者一小袋豆和花生。

张凤群经常回乡探望父母。在乡间生活期间，她读了《三国演义》《儒林外史》《东周列国志》等古典小说。

21岁时，她开始尝试离开大陆前往香港。

前两次行动均告失败。她曾分别从淡水方向和光明农场一带尝试出境，都被民兵抓获，并因此两次被关押。

1971年9月，她第三次尝试逃往香港。

张凤群后来回忆，她接到朋友通知后前往番禺沙湾。次日，她和朋友以及其他人乘坐一条小船，从珠江水系向南航行。

船上共有九人。驾船者是一位约六十岁的老人，曾当过海员。为了隐蔽，船上堆放稻草，出发时张凤群等人藏在稻草下面。

船只经过虎门以后进入珠江口。夜间海上风浪逐渐增大，船上没有指南针，一度偏离方向。小船大量进水，船上人员一边划桨，一边不停向外舀水。

航行途中，小船还险些与一艘大型货船相撞。

天亮以后，他们遇见海上渔船。渔民指示远处山脉的方向，船上的人由此确认前方是大屿山。

最终，小船在香港靠岸。从沙湾出发到登岸，前后约20个小时。

张凤群当时23岁。

此后，她在香港生活多年，后来移居美国。

1985年，张凤群报考美国邮政系统的工作。按照她后来的回忆，考试除笔试外，还包括与分拣工作相关的速度和准确性测试。她通过考试后进入邮政部门工作。约一年后，她的丈夫也进入邮政系统。

夫妻两人在美国逐渐建立起稳定生活，后来购置住房。张凤群一直在邮政系统工作到2015年退休。

与此同时，她重新开始中文写作。

由于长期生活海外，最初重新写中文时，她的文字表达并不十分熟练。经过持续练习，她开始大量记录自己在广州、“文化大革命”、逃港、香港生活以及美国生活中的经历。

此后，她在北美《世界日报》发表了约70篇文章，又在网络平台发表近200篇作品，逐渐成为一名业余作者。

她的写作内容大多来自个人经历和家庭记忆。其中包括父亲行医的往事、童年生活、逃港经历，以及普通人在政治运动和社会变迁中的命运。

2015年，张凤群回到广州参加初中同学聚会。昔日同学已经分别生活在中国、香港和海外数十年。

聚会上，她朗诵了杜甫《赠卫八处士》中的诗句：

人生不相见，动如参与商。
今夕复何夕，共此灯烛光。

此时距离她离开广州，已经过去四十多年。

资料来源：崔干行《天边那一抹彩虹》

item.title: 监狱琐记71：附录四 野驴顾惟乔
item.description:
来源: 
监狱琐记

顾惟乔是我从1957年9月到1960年8月在北京六十五中上高中时的同班同学，“野驴”是他的绰号。

一、独特的1960届

按照通常的称呼，我们那届叫做1960届高中毕业生，建国六十年，已经有了60届高中毕业生了，然而1960届仍然可以说是很独特的一届，特别是那届北京的高中毕业生。

特殊在哪？

其一，1957年我们初中毕业，那年正逢经济紧缩（“整风反右”就与此有关），高中招生缩水（这正是“汉阳一中事件”的背景），能考上高中的是少数。

其二，在此之前，上学读书是再正常不过的事，可是从我们这届起，政治运动成了学生的主课。三年高中学习生活中，政治运动占去了一大半时间，而且在运动中不断地打压学生读书求知的欲望。1957年秋天，一开学就碰上教师“反右”，眼看着许多老师划为右派，包括延安来的独臂校长和一大批饱学的、教学效果很好的教师，以此告诫学生，单纯追求知识是很危险的。

这三年，学生也没闲着，投入各种名目的运动，细数起来，有十来个。例如“社会主义教育”，“批判个人主义”，“双反，向党交心”，“拔白旗，插红旗”，“红专教育”“教育改革”（包括教育为无产阶级政治服务和教育与生产劳动相结合），“四化”（生活集体化、组织军事化、行动战斗化、思想革命化），“大炼钢铁”（把原有钢铁烧成废渣），“搞超声波”（制造“科学”神话），“建设劳动生产基地”（盖了两个小化工厂，后全部报废），“社会主义大辩论”……如果都写出来，今人很难理解，甚至怀疑我们那一代人是不是精神上出了问题。

政治运动的核心除了劳动外，就是学习当时各种文件，联系自己的现实思想（当时上面认为青年学生的思想状况，除了一小部分外，大多是小资产阶级的或资产阶级的），向党交心，在自我批判的基础上互相“帮助”，互相揭发批判。因此学生里的一点小事都可能引发一次班会，甚至校会，对有问题的同学大批判。最可笑的是所谓“大辩论”，辩论的多是空洞的、永远说不清的问题。比如，“共产主义哪天到？谁来宣布？中国还是苏联？”“到共产主义是不是要什么有什么？如果大家都想听梅兰芳怎么办？”“是坐小汽车对人民贡献大（指官员）？还是开小汽车的对人民贡献大（指工人）？我们应该做‘坐小汽车的’？还是应该做‘开小汽车的’？”（提这个问题的同学曾被表扬，说问题提得好，但他没考上大学）“我们的人民公社是不是比苏联的集体农庄更先进？”“我们一定会先进入共产主义，至少也是与苏联一块进？”而且这些问题一争起来就没完没了，老师也解决不了。

其三，三年高中，不断折腾。那时整个社会好像患了多动症，一时一刻不能停息。学校也是这样，几乎每天都能有点新花样。不仅政治运动纳入了教育课程，超常的体力劳动，也在顶替着正常的教学，学生不能读书，看点课外书就是“白专”。而且体育、跳舞、游行（那时大型的政治游行特别多）都在挤占学生的时间。大跃进时流行的一个词就是“比学赶帮超”，关键点是“超”，什么都“超”。例如体育上要求达到“五红”——通过一级劳卫制（“劳动卫国体育制度”的简称，每级对跑、跳、垫上、鞍马、单双杠都有要求）、二级劳卫制、三级运动员、三级裁判、普通射手等，目的是“超武汉”。

三年中唯一的一次重视学习，也与“超”有关。1959年春末夏初的一天，北京市教育局召开1960届全体同学开誓师大会，要求高考成绩超福建，争第一（1950年代高考状元往往是福建、上海轮流，北京老是位居第三）。为了做到这一点，应届毕业生一律住校。当然住了校，也不能停止政治运动，学习课程依然没保障。只是同学之间，接触多了，班上又有两三位专爱打小报告的，互相扯皮反而增多了。用那时同学的话说给了“无产阶级与资产阶级思想正面交锋的机会”，于是辩论会、帮助会自然也成了家常便饭。学校为了争取好成绩费了很大劲，可是到了高考录取的时候，考分根本不作数了，完全看政审（家庭、“政治表现”）。审卷的只用四个图章：1.可录取机密专业；2.可录取一般专业；3.降格录取；4.不宜录取。图章一盖，完事大吉。1960年，全国高中毕业生20万人，那年扩招（大跃进中新建了许多大学，多是中专戴帽升级），招23万人，许多没考大学的（如高中留校生），社会青年、初中毕业生以同等学力考的，都有大学上，可是偏偏有许多优秀毕业生却名落孙山。

顾惟乔是我们这届同学中的佼佼者，他以青年人的热情适应着时代的颠簸，仿佛是个时代的弄潮儿，自由而优美地徜徉在波峰波谷之间。

选自王学泰著《监狱琐记》，生活·读书·新知三联书店，2013年10月

item.title: 日经分析：中共最高军事机构的“空心化”会持续多久？
item.description:
如果要让中央军委恢复到2022年的七人架构，就需要任命五名新成员。 按照惯例，国防部长董军应当是候选人之一。他的前任李尚福在落马前也是中央军委委员。 董军拥有海军上将军衔，于2023年底出任国防部长，负责中国军事外交事务。 但在去年10月召开的中共二十届四中全会上，董军并未获晋升为中央军委委员。 如果现有军事领导体制基本能够正常运转，习近平也牢牢掌握着军队指挥权，实际上能够绕过中央军委其他成员，直接向解放军下级部队下达命令，那么他完全可以选择维持现状，直到明年的中共全国代表大会。 习近平最终是选择重建中央军委领导层，还是继续让这个机构处于空心化状态，或许能够揭示他究竟在多大程度上巩固了对军队的个人控制。

item.title: 彭博观点：特朗普面临的第二次中期选举会比第一次更糟
item.description:
近两年前，美国选民再次将特朗普送入白宫时，完全清楚自己选的是什么样的人。2016年底和2017年初曾经普遍存在的那种天真期待，认为这位善于挑起争议的民粹主义者终有一天会转变为稳重的政治家，早已不复存在。 取而代之的是一种务实的乐观情绪。选民希望这位曾经担任总统、即将重返白宫的领导人能够遏制居高不下的通胀，同时恢复他们记忆中特朗普第一任期、新冠疫情暴发前的国际局势稳定和经济繁荣。 但特朗普未能解决这些基本问题，如今正让共和党在国会的多数席位岌岌可危。

item.title: Netflix裁减电影和电视高管，暗示节目制作面临困境
item.description:
休伯在周三裁员消息公布前发表的一份研究报告中写道：“无论从绝对数量来看，还是与前几年相比，Netflix都缺少能够脱颖而出的作品或重大热门剧集。这让人担心，公司能否吸引大量新订阅用户，同时留住现有用户。” 休伯还认为，Netflix决定从2027年开始，将用户观看情况报告的发布频率从每半年一次改为每年一次，是一个“不好的信号”。这份报告可以反映哪些内容最受订阅用户欢迎。 追踪移动应用使用情况的研究公司Apptopia也发现，有迹象表明Netflix订阅用户使用平台的时间正在减少。 今年第三季度，美国订阅用户中没有打开过Netflix应用程序的用户占比，同比上升16.6%。

item.description:

3．段祺瑞是一个围棋迷，吴清源11岁时曾受邀到段府，大家跟段祺瑞下棋，都知道让他三分，吴清源年纪小，哪管那么多，杀得段祺瑞片甲不留，段祺瑞依旧按月资助吴清源生活费跟学费，每月100元，后来段还送吴清源去日本学围棋。那个时候一个仆人一个月薪水是2元。

item.title: U.S. may have withheld warnings to Ukraine on deadly Kyiv strikes
item.description:
The U.S. may have intentionally withheld early warnings this week of Russian strikes on Ukraine, multiple sources familiar with the matter told CBS News.

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine "received no advance warning from our partners" when Russia launched a ballistic missile barrage at Kyiv and other locations early Tuesday. 

The sources said American officials told their Ukrainian counterparts the system used to detect Russian missile launches had failed due to "bad weather." Ukrainian officials, speaking on the condition of anonymity given the sensitivity of the topic, told CBS News they did not believe the excuse, and they accused the U.S. instead of "playing" with the system. 

When Russia launched another wave of ballistic missiles around 3 a.m. local time on Wednesday, the sources said the U.S. early warning system appeared to be working again. 

The sources said the U.S. had failed to provide intelligence on Russian ballistic missile launches during one previous instance earlier this year, citing the need to focus more resources on the Middle East.

Zelenskyy said Wednesday that Russia launched more than 39 ballistic missiles and more than 120 attack drones and loitering munitions during the overnight attack, primarily targeting energy and critical infrastructure in Kyiv and Kharkiv, killing six people and leaving some 600,000 without power. 

President Trump, asked Tuesday if the U.S. had stopped sharing intelligence with Ukraine, said: "No, we haven't. We help them, but we're really helping them get to a final answer. We want the war ended."

"We are helping them, and we are sharing intel. We want the war to end, so we're working with them and with Russia on getting the war to end," Mr. Trump said.

Russia started launching strikes soon after Mr. Trump said in a social media post on Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an "energy ceasefire."

Earlier this week, the Trump administration threatened to stop sharing intelligence and to halt the purchase of U.S.-made weapons by European allies for Ukraine via the PURL procurement system if Ukraine did not stop deep strikes against Russian energy infrastructure, a European and a Ukrainian official told CBS News.

Ukraine relies on U.S. intelligence for both offensive and defensive military capabilities, including data from satellites and aircraft sensors used to identify launches of Russian aircraft and missiles. Sources familiar with the matter told CBS News the U.S. had not ceased intelligence sharing with Ukraine overall — calling the lack of a warning about this week's attacks a specific incident. 

Ukrainian officials and soldiers also told CBS News that Ukraine's military had started experiencing difficulties Tuesday night and Wednesday morning with Starlink, the satellite technology owned by SpaceX's Elon Musk. 

In an interview with CBS News earlier this year, Ukraine's former minister of defense Mykhailo Fedorov said Starlink was one of Ukraine's most important technologies, as it allows Ukrainian soldiers to communicate and carry out strikes in environments saturated by electronic warfare. 

"On the night of 14 October, without warning the Defence Forces, SpaceX unilaterally restricted the operation of Starshield terminals ('military package') while in motion. This complicates UAV missions, particularly interceptors and middle-strike drones, and reduces capabilities for frontline logistics, reconnaissance and signal relay," sources in Ukraine's Ministry of Defense told CBS News. "At present, the Ministry of Defence is in contact with the United States, SpaceX and NATO partners, is collecting data from all units, and backup communication channels are being tested and put into use."

The Starlink restrictions were first reported by the Kyiv Independent and the Financial Times. CBS News has reached out to SpaceX, the White House, and the Pentagon for comment. 

On Wednesday, as President Zelenskyy arrived in the United Kingdom to meet with Prime Minister Andy Burnham and other officials, he called for a U.S. response to the recent Russian strikes.

"The strike was absolutely deliberate and indicative in its scale — such a demonstrative disrespect from Russia toward America has never happened before. Russia does not consider the statements of the President of America to be strong," he wrote on X. "We ask America and EVERYONE in the world who does not close their eyes to reality to respond, and to respond harshly."

This article originally appeared on CBS News at https://www.cbsnews.com/news/us-ukraine-intelligence-russia-war-missile-strikes-kyiv-power-outages/

item.title: 川普警告伊朗：美国已经“受够了”
item.description:
来源: 
来稿

美国总统川普10月13日在阿拉斯加举行的一场政治集会上再次向伊朗发出强硬警告，称美国对德黑兰的行动已经“差不多受够了”，并表示外界将看到美国下一步如何应对伊朗。

川普说：“等着看我们怎么对付伊朗。我们会给他们好看……他们现在坐在那里等着，看我们会怎么做，因为我们差不多已经受够了。”他同时重申，伊朗绝不能拥有核武器，并称伊朗核设施已经遭到严重破坏。

川普没有公布下一步军事行动的具体时间表，也没有明确说明美国是否准备扩大对伊朗的空袭。但在霍尔木兹海峡安全局势持续恶化之际，这番表态再次显示，美方仍保留进一步采取军事行动的选择。

美国中央司令部近日表示，美军正在中东测试新的无人机和通信能力，并继续与地区盟友加强军事协调。美军称，10月12日曾协助地区伙伴一天内将超过1900万桶原油安全运出霍尔木兹海峡。

与此同时，海峡附近针对商船的袭击仍在增加。新加坡海事及港务管理局证实，新加坡籍货柜船“GFS Pride”在航经霍尔木兹海峡附近时遭不明发射物击中，随后起火沉没，船上21名船员全部安全撤离。

路透社引述伊朗高级官员报道，在美国摧毁伊朗大量雷达设施后，伊朗革命卫队开始使用小型船只上的非武装观察人员寻找潜在目标，包括美国海军舰艇。伊朗方面希望通过增加航运风险推高能源成本，并在美国中期选举前向华盛顿施加压力。

能源市场已经受到明显冲击。美国9月消费者物价指数环比上涨0.6%，其中汽油价格单月上涨9.1%。国际能源署警告，由于中东冲突以及俄乌战争影响炼油和燃料供应，全球柴油市场紧张局面可能持续至2027年。

随着商船遇袭、能源成本上升以及美伊军事对抗延续，川普最新警告显示，华盛顿对伊朗进一步采取行动的可能性仍在上升，但美国政府尚未公布新的军事行动时间表。

关键词: 
川普
伊朗
栏目: 
时事见解
栏目重点发表: 
栏目头条
作者: 
金右澜

item.title: 美国9月份消费者价格上涨，汽油价格上涨是主因
item.description:
来源: 
美国之音

受汽油价格飙升的驱动，美国9月份消费者价格上涨速度加快。

美国劳工统计局星期三（10月14日）报告，9月份消费者价格指数（CPI）上涨0.6%，8月份的涨幅是0.4%。

截至9月份的12个月内，消费者物价指数（CPI）上涨了3.7%，高于8月份同期3.4%的涨幅。

星期三公布的数据显示，9月份汽油价格上涨了9.1%，是上个月涨幅的两倍多。

9月份整体能源价格上涨了5.2%，过去一年累计上涨超过20%。

食品价格总体稳定，但肉类、鱼类、蛋类和乳制品等类别的价格有所下降。

美国劳工统计局使用消费者物价指数（CPI）来跟踪人们为商品和服务支付的价格随时间的变化。

这项指数是一项备受关注的经济指标，包括美联储在决定是否调整利率时都会参考这个指数。

 

关键词: 
美国
栏目: 
要闻

item.title: 台湾参与阿拉斯加天然气项目能源交易背后有哪些考量？
item.description:
来源: 
美国之音

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）10月13日宣布，台湾同意在未来20年内购买阿拉斯加液化天然气项目30%的天然气，并投资44亿美元。

台湾经济部星期三证实，台湾中油与项目开发商的磋商已取得“重大进展”，但股权比例和其他条款仍待确定。

阿拉斯加项目是什么？

这是一项预计耗资445亿至545亿美元的能源工程，计划铺设约1300公里长的管道，将阿拉斯加北部天然气输送至南部设施，液化后出口亚洲。项目最快可能于2032年投产，但高昂成本和融资难题长期阻碍其推进。

阿拉斯加拥有丰富的天然气资源。美国能源信息署（EIA）的数据显示，截至2024年底，阿拉斯加已探明天然气储量约为103万亿立方英尺（约2.9万亿立方米），较前一年增长近7%。其中，北坡地区是阿拉斯加液化天然气项目计划开发的主要气源地之一。

台湾承诺了什么？

台湾预计每年采购600万吨天然气，并投资44亿美元。台湾经济部说，阿拉斯加液化天然气计划具备地理位置优势，可以通过太平洋航线直达台湾。台湾希望通过长期能源采购促进天然气供应多元性，强化台湾的能源韧性。

交易为何重要？

对美国而言，台湾的参与可能为一项长期受阻的能源出口计划带来买家和资金。该项目符合特朗普政府扩大国内能源生产和出口的政策方向，也可能为阿拉斯加带来投资和就业机会。

特朗普总统星期三（10月14日）在他的真相社交（Truth Social）上发文，称台湾这项投资是“历史上最大的采购协议”，他说，“我今天宣布，我的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克（Howard Lutnick）已从台湾获得了阿拉斯加液化天然气项目的700到800亿美元的采购承诺，这将占未来20年管道产出的30%。这是历史上最大的采购协议。除此之外，台湾还同意向该项目投资44亿美元。”

特朗普还表示，阿拉斯加液化天然气项目是一个美国联邦政府项目，“所有必要的许可都已获得，所有必要的批准都已完成，随时可以启动。是阿拉斯加历史上最伟大的项目。”

对台湾而言，采购美国天然气有助于分散供应来源，降低对现有进口渠道的依赖。长期合同也可能帮助台湾锁定一定数量的供应，降低临时采购的不确定性。

国际危机组织东北亚高级分析员杨皓玮（William Yang）在X发文表示，特朗普总统的宣布，应被视为“承认台湾是一个帮助推动美国国内经济发展的伙伴”。他表示，这一自去年就开始筹备的计划，“有助于台湾从液化天然气和中东石油中分散能源来源，并加深美台经济联系。”

交易有哪些风险？

项目成本高、建设周期长，延期或超支都可能影响商业可行性。长期采购合同也可能限制台湾未来调整采购的空间。

此外，44亿美元投资的具体安排、天然气价格及最终采购条款仍需进一步确认。

北京怎么说？

中国外交部星期三批评台湾参与该项目，称台湾对外事务“应以一个中国原则为基础”。发言人毛宁指责民进党借经贸之名推动“台独”。

北京声称台湾是中国领土的一部分；台湾由民选政府治理，拒绝接受北京的主权主张。这也显示，能源合作仍可能受到两岸政治关系影响。

接下来关注什么？

这项交易能否从政治宣布走向实际建设，关键在于台湾与开发商能否签署正式协议、项目能否落实融资，以及建设是否按计划推进。

核心总结

对台湾而言，这项安排提供了增加美国天然气供应、分散能源来源的潜在机会；对美国而言，它可能帮助推动一项长期受阻的能源出口计划。

但在最终协议、融资和建设计划进一步明确之前，44亿美元的投资安排和长期采购承诺仍应被视为一项有待落实的合作进展，而不是项目已经取得商业成功的证明。

关键词: 
台湾
栏目: 
时事见解
首页重点发表:

item.title: 加美财经解释：Anthropic营收激增，为何近2万亿美元IPO估值仍然被质疑？
item.description:
最新投资者会议传递出一个积极信号：Anthropic的商业收入仍在迅速扩张，调整后盈利能力也有所改善。 但微软和Meta控制Claude支出、长期算力合同规模巨大，以及对少数大型合作伙伴的依赖，都可能成为上市投资者关注的重点。 齐特龙等批评者认为，AI公司的融资需求已经远远超过当前经营现金流能够支持的水平。如果债务融资环境进一步恶化，持续依赖外部资本的商业模式可能承受越来越大的压力。 这种判断目前还不能作为Anthropic必然陷入财务困境的证据。公司最新披露的收入和盈利改善，恰恰说明AI商业化进展比部分悲观预测更快。 真正尚未解决的，是未来收入、利润和资本需求之间能否形成稳定关系。 对于考虑购买Anthropic股票的投资者，最值得关注的将是正式招股说明书中的完整财务报表、客户收入结构、长期合同付款时间表、现金储备，以及未来几年的资本需求预测。

item.title: 中国出口激增，年度贸易顺差有望再次刷新纪录
item.description:
KEITH BRADSHER
2026年10月15日

A record-setting surge in China’s exports dwarfed its imports in September, as the country’s vast manufacturing sector churned out cars, solar panels, electrical equipment and other goods for markets worldwide.

中国出口在9月的创纪录激增使其进口相形见绌，该国庞大的制造业部门为全球市场生产了汽车、太阳能电池板、电气设备和其他商品。

China’s General Administration of Customs said the country recorded a $133.5 billion trade surplus last month, the second-highest month ever. The latest figures put China on course to considerably exceed last year’s record $1.19 trillion trade surplus.

中国海关总署表示，中国上月录得1335亿美元的贸易顺差，为有史以来第二高的月份。最新数据使中国有望大幅超过去年创纪录的1.19万亿美元贸易顺差。

Another month of skyrocketing exports is expected to further stoke tensions with many trading partners, including in Europe, where anger over the flood of Chinese vehicles and other items is prompting some leaders to propose a so-called “kill switch” to shut out goods from China.

出口再次飙升预计将进一步加剧与许多贸易伙伴的紧张关系，包括欧洲。在那里，对中国汽车和其他商品大量涌入的愤怒正促使一些领导人提议所谓的“紧急切断开关”，以将中国商品拒之门外。

Economists disagree on how much of China’s enormous trade surplus is driven by stronger exports and how much stems from weaker imports. A weak currency has helped make Chinese goods more competitive overseas, while raising the cost of imported products at home.

对于中国巨大的贸易顺差有多少由出口走强驱动，又有多少源于进口疲软，经济学家们存在分歧。疲软的货币使中国商品在海外更具竞争力，同时提高了国内进口产品的成本。

The value of the renminbi, China’s currency, has fallen more than 14 percent in inflation-adjusted terms against a broad set of currencies since March 2022, according to the Bank of International Settlements, an institution owned by the world’s central banks, including China’s. March 2022 was when China began a two-month Covid-19 lockdown in Shanghai, which dealt a lasting blow to consumer confidence.

据国际清算银行称，自2022年3月以来，人民币经通胀调整后的价值相对于广泛的一篮子货币下跌了超过14%。国际清算银行由世界各国央行共同拥有，包括中国央行。2022年3月，中国开始在上海实施为期两个月的新冠疫情封锁，对消费者信心造成了持久打击。

Broad tax breaks for exporters have also fueled the export boom. The incentives cost China’s finance ministry about $318 billion last year.

对出口商的广泛税收减免也推动了出口繁荣。这些激励措施去年使中国财政部花费了约3180亿美元。

The customs agency said exports soared 36.3 percent in September from a year earlier. It was the largest year-on-year percentage gain in Chinese exports since July 2010, excluding months distorted by the timing of Lunar New Year.

海关机构表示，9月出口同比增长36.3%。这是自2010年7月以来中国出口最大的同比百分比增幅，不包括因农历新年时间而数据偏差的月份。

Exports climbed to a record $447.2 billion. September’s trade surplus trailed only January 2025, when the timing of Lunar New Year prompted Chinese exporters to rush orders before the extended holiday.

出口攀升至创纪录的4472亿美元。9月的贸易顺差仅次于2025年1月，当时农历新年的时间促使中国出口商在长假前赶订单。

Despite the export surge, Beijing has been reluctant to cut tax breaks for exporters or to allow the currency to appreciate sharply, fearing job losses in industries already squeezed by tariffs. In Guangzhou, a garment manufacturing hub, producers are struggling to compete with lower-wage countries.

尽管出口激增，但由于担心已在关税压力下的行业出现失业，北京仍不愿削减对出口商的税收减免或允许人民币大幅升值。在广州这个服装制造中心，生产商正艰难地与低工资国家竞争。

On a recent afternoon, a factory making padded jackets was nearly deserted because it lacked orders. “If you’re producing for export, there are tariffs to deal with, and fabric and labor are expensive, so a lot of people don’t want to do exports anymore,” said the factory’s manager, who gave his family name, Ling.

在最近的一个下午，一家生产棉服外套的工厂几乎空无一人，因为没有订单。“如果你为出口生产，就要应对关税，而且面料和劳动力都很贵，所以很多人不想再做出口了，”该工厂的经理说。他只提供了自己的姓氏“凌”（音）。

At the same time, a prolonged housing market crash and rising unemployment have left many Chinese households reluctant to spend. Beijing has also poured government support into building domestic manufacturing industries, reducing the country’s reliance on imported goods.

与此同时，旷日持久的房地产市场崩溃和不断上升的失业率使许多中国家庭不愿消费。北京还向国内制造业提供了大量支持，减少了中国对进口商品的依赖。

Chinese companies are also pinched by rising raw material costs and weak consumer demand that leaves little room to raise prices. Factory-gate and mining prices rose 5 percent in September from a year earlier, the National Bureau of Statistics reported on Wednesday, while consumer prices increased just 0.9 percent.

中国企业还受到原材料成本上升和消费者需求疲软的双重挤压，后者导致几乎没有提价空间。国家统计局周三报告称，9月出厂价格和采矿价格同比上涨5%，而消费者价格仅上涨0.9%。

Sluggish consumer demand and expanding domestic production have depressed imports of almost everything except raw materials such as oil and copper, much of which are used to manufacture further exports. Imports rose 31 percent in September from the same month a year earlier, partly because imported oil costs rose substantially.

低迷的消费者需求和不断扩大的国内生产压低了除石油和铜等原材料以外几乎所有商品的进口，这些原材料大部分用于制造进一步的出口产品。9月进口同比增长31%，部分原因是进口石油成本大幅上涨。

China’s auto industry offers a particularly stark picture of the divide between weak domestic demand and booming exports. Retail car sales plunged 28 percent in September from a year earlier, according to the China Passenger Car Association, which works closely with the country’s car dealers

中国汽车行业提供了一个尤其鲜明的画面，展示了疲软的国内需求与蓬勃发展的出口之间的鸿沟。据与中国汽车经销商密切合作的中国乘用车协会称，9月零售汽车销量同比暴跌28%。

From the summer of 2024 through the end of 2025, China offered generous subsidies to encourage consumers to trade in older gas guzzlers for electric cars and plug-in, gasoline-electric hybrid cars. The program brought forward purchases that might otherwise have taken place this year, contributing to the current sales slump.

从2024年夏季到2025年底，中国提供了慷慨的补贴，鼓励消费者以旧换新，将旧的高油耗汽车换成纯电和插电式汽油-电动混合动力汽车。该计划提前了本可能今年发生的购买，导致了当前的销售暴跌。

But the broader economic slowdown now appears to be taking a greater toll than the expiration of those incentives. The number of cars sold at dealerships in September was also down nearly 20 percent below the level in September 2023, before the trade-in program began.

但更广泛的经济放缓眼下所造成的影响似乎比这些激励措施的到期更大。9月经销商售出的汽车数量相比2023年9月——以旧换新计划开始之前——的水平也低了近20%。

While domestic sales have faltered, China’s car exports have soared, and are up 11-fold since 2020. The flood of Chinese-made vehicles into overseas markets has alarmed automakers elsewhere, particularly in Europe.

虽然国内销售已经动摇，中国的汽车出口却飙升，自2020年以来增长了11倍。中国制造的汽车大量涌入海外市场，令其他地方的汽车制造商感到震惊，尤其是在欧洲。

On Friday, the European Union and China said they had reached an “understanding” to limit China’s exports of plug-in hybrid cars to Europe. China’s trade surplus set another record with Europe last month.

周五，欧盟和中国表示他们已达成“谅解”，以限制中国向欧洲出口插电式混合动力汽车。中国上个月与欧洲的贸易顺差再创纪录。

China’s manufacturing exports have surged since it joined the World Trade Organization in 2001, when Beijing pledged to open financial services, including credit cards, to foreign competition. After 25 years of delays, during which China built its own electronic payments system, Visa announced Tuesday that Beijing took a step toward letting it establish a bank card clearing business, though further approvals are needed.

自2001年中国加入世界贸易组织以来，中国的制造业出口大幅增长，当时北京承诺向外国竞争开放金融服务，包括信用卡。在25年的拖延之后——中国利用这段时间建立了自己的电子支付系统，Visa周二宣布北京已采取措施允许其建立银行卡清算业务，但仍需进一步批准。

After decades of American complaints about delays, the Visa decision, along with the compromise with Europe on plug-in hybrid cars, suggests Beijing may be taking small steps to address foreign concerns about its trade surplus.

数十年来美国一直就这一拖延表达不满，Visa的决定以及就插电式混合动力汽车与欧洲达成的妥协表明，北京可能正在采取小步骤来解决外国对其贸易顺差的关切。

Ruoxin Zhang对本文有研究贡献。

Keith Bradsher是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。

翻译：纽约时报中文网

item.title: 中国出口激增，年度贸易顺差有望再次刷新纪录
item.description:
KEITH BRADSHER
2026年10月15日

中国出口在9月的创纪录激增使其进口相形见绌，该国庞大的制造业部门为全球市场生产了汽车、太阳能电池板、电气设备和其他商品。

中国海关总署表示，中国上月录得1335亿美元的贸易顺差，为有史以来第二高的月份。最新数据使中国有望大幅超过去年创纪录的1.19万亿美元贸易顺差。

出口再次飙升预计将进一步加剧与许多贸易伙伴的紧张关系，包括欧洲。在那里，对中国汽车和其他商品大量涌入的愤怒正促使一些领导人提议所谓的“紧急切断开关”，以将中国商品拒之门外。

对于中国巨大的贸易顺差有多少由出口走强驱动，又有多少源于进口疲软，经济学家们存在分歧。疲软的货币使中国商品在海外更具竞争力，同时提高了国内进口产品的成本。

据国际清算银行称，自2022年3月以来，人民币经通胀调整后的价值相对于广泛的一篮子货币下跌了超过14%。国际清算银行由世界各国央行共同拥有，包括中国央行。2022年3月，中国开始在上海实施为期两个月的新冠疫情封锁，对消费者信心造成了持久打击。

对出口商的广泛税收减免也推动了出口繁荣。这些激励措施去年使中国财政部花费了约3180亿美元。

海关机构表示，9月出口同比增长36.3%。这是自2010年7月以来中国出口最大的同比百分比增幅，不包括因农历新年时间而数据偏差的月份。

出口攀升至创纪录的4472亿美元。9月的贸易顺差仅次于2025年1月，当时农历新年的时间促使中国出口商在长假前赶订单。

尽管出口激增，但由于担心已在关税压力下的行业出现失业，北京仍不愿削减对出口商的税收减免或允许人民币大幅升值。在广州这个服装制造中心，生产商正艰难地与低工资国家竞争。

在最近的一个下午，一家生产棉服外套的工厂几乎空无一人，因为没有订单。“如果你为出口生产，就要应对关税，而且面料和劳动力都很贵，所以很多人不想再做出口了，”该工厂的经理说。他只提供了自己的姓氏“凌”（音）。

与此同时，旷日持久的房地产市场崩溃和不断上升的失业率使许多中国家庭不愿消费。北京还向国内制造业提供了大量支持，减少了中国对进口商品的依赖。

中国企业还受到原材料成本上升和消费者需求疲软的双重挤压，后者导致几乎没有提价空间。国家统计局周三报告称，9月出厂价格和采矿价格同比上涨5%，而消费者价格仅上涨0.9%。

低迷的消费者需求和不断扩大的国内生产压低了除石油和铜等原材料以外几乎所有商品的进口，这些原材料大部分用于制造进一步的出口产品。9月进口同比增长31%，部分原因是进口石油成本大幅上涨。

中国汽车行业提供了一个尤其鲜明的画面，展示了疲软的国内需求与蓬勃发展的出口之间的鸿沟。据与中国汽车经销商密切合作的中国乘用车协会称，9月零售汽车销量同比暴跌28%。

从2024年夏季到2025年底，中国提供了慷慨的补贴，鼓励消费者以旧换新，将旧的高油耗汽车换成纯电和插电式汽油-电动混合动力汽车。该计划提前了本可能今年发生的购买，导致了当前的销售暴跌。

但更广泛的经济放缓眼下所造成的影响似乎比这些激励措施的到期更大。9月经销商售出的汽车数量相比2023年9月——以旧换新计划开始之前——的水平也低了近20%。

虽然国内销售已经动摇，中国的汽车出口却飙升，自2020年以来增长了11倍。中国制造的汽车大量涌入海外市场，令其他地方的汽车制造商感到震惊，尤其是在欧洲。

周五，欧盟和中国表示他们已达成“谅解”，以限制中国向欧洲出口插电式混合动力汽车。中国上个月与欧洲的贸易顺差再创纪录。

自2001年中国加入世界贸易组织以来，中国的制造业出口大幅增长，当时北京承诺向外国竞争开放金融服务，包括信用卡。在25年的拖延之后——中国利用这段时间建立了自己的电子支付系统，Visa周二宣布北京已采取措施允许其建立银行卡清算业务，但仍需进一步批准。

数十年来美国一直就这一拖延表达不满，Visa的决定以及就插电式混合动力汽车与欧洲达成的妥协表明，北京可能正在采取小步骤来解决外国对其贸易顺差的关切。

Ruoxin Zhang对本文有研究贡献。

Keith Bradsher是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。

item.title: 美联储《褐皮书》：美国经济放缓，物价上涨压力加剧
item.description:
美联储10月14日发布的最新《褐皮书》显示，美国12个联储辖区中，9个经济活动有所增长，3个基本停滞。多数地区消费支出疲弱，企业招聘谨慎，但4个辖区物价涨幅加快，能源、关税和运输成本持续推高企业经营压力。当天公布的9月CPI同比上涨3.7%，超出预期，进一步增加通胀担忧。经济增长乏力与物价压力加剧并存，使美联储面临更困难的利率抉择，市场对进一步加息的预期随之升温。
